name: @avatark/living-rhythms-runtime
description: Executes Sprint 13's living-rhythms derivation: deterministic day-phase resolution, resource-opportunity derivation, routine/group-routine resolution, place occupancy/rhythm derivation, and social-interaction-opportunity resolution. Host-neutral, database-neutral, franchise-neutral, zero scripted timetables.

scripts.test: node --experimental-strip-types --test src/dayPhaseResolution.test.ts src/resourceOpportunityResolution.test.ts src/routineResolution.test.ts src/groupRoutineResolution.test.ts src/placeOccupancyResolution.test.ts src/placeRhythmEvolution.test.ts src/socialInteractionResolution.test.ts
scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json --outDir dist --declaration --noEmit false --rewriteRelativeImportExtensions --module esnext --moduleResolution bundler && node ../../scripts/fix-dts-extensions.mjs dist
